BiblicalUsage: Puah was one of the Hebrew midwives in Egypt, named with Shiphrah. The king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives, of which the name of the one was Shiphrah, and the name of the other Puah, and commanded them to kill the male children at birth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Puah's name is remembered because she feared God more than Pharaoh: the king commanded death, and the midwives saved the children alive.
